comments.body: Hi, I'm starting my first year in the MSc in Spatial Development and Infrastructure Systems program, and I was wondering if you had any advice in finding jobs? I am interested in working in the transportation institute, but couldn't find any job openings in the ETH job portal. I'm also particularly interested in MATSim, but noticed the center is located in Singapore. Do you have any recommendations on who to email or contact? I have a pretty solid programming background (computer science minor in undergrad), and have some macro modelling and microsimulation experience. Thanks in advance!
comments.author: Turbulent-Freedom325
